params.1273:
You must get past the dragon.

Take some drugged meat from Sir Vant's bag, then find a way to climb over the broken wall near Sir Vant into the main room of the cellar.

For more information on this Task, click on the Hints tab above.
params.1292: Completing this Task will help you escape from the cellar in which you find yourself.
params.1274: Pick up some drugged meat from Sir Vant's bag by clicking on it.
params.1275: The wall is too high to climb without aid.
params.1276: There is a plank next to the wall; click on it to pick it up.
